'''Sarina''' was a [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] where members of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] operated. Rebels patrolled the planet on creatures called [[Sand hopper]]s.<ref name="Jedi Weekly" />

{{Planet-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Sarina was mentioned in a feature called ''Build this super stand-up model'', which could be cut out of the comic book and folded into a paper model of a Rebel on a sand hopper.

[[Jason Fry]], co-author of ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', indicated in [[March]] [[2023]] that Sarina was validated for a future update of [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|''The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion]].<ref name="Email">{{EmailCite|email=File:EAOC discussion 2023.jpg|creator=Jason Fry|date=2023-03-25}}</ref>
